# xui_masque_client (Resource)

MASQUE user (client) on an existing `masque` inbound. Managed via `/panel/api/clients/*` (add, get, update, del).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xui_inbound" "example" {
  protocol = "masque"
  remark   = "example-masque"
  port     = 8447
  settings = jsonencode({
    clients = []
    address = ["10.14.0.1/24", "fd14::1/64"]
  })
  stream_settings = jsonencode({
    network  = "tcp"
    security = "tls"
  })
  sniffing = "{}"
}

resource "xui_masque_client" "example" {
  inbound_id = xui_inbound.example.id
  email      = "masque-client@example.com"
  # password omitted — the panel generates one
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Unique client email / label in the panel.
- `inbound_id` (Number) Panel inbound id (number from URL / API).

### Optional

- `client_host_rule_ids` (List of Number) Host rule IDs this client's subscriptions are bound to (`clientHostRuleIds`). Omit to leave the panel value unchanged; set to `[]` to clear. Hosts themselves are not managed by this provider yet.
- `comment` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `expiry_time` (Number) Expiry in milliseconds since Unix epoch (0 = never).
- `group` (String) Client group label (`group`). Empty means the client is not in a group.
- `limit_hwid` (Number) Per-client subscription HWID device limit (`limitHwid`; 0 = unlimited).
- `limit_ip` (Number)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) MASQUE client password. If omitted, the panel generates one on create.
- `reset` (Number) Rolling auto-renew interval in days (`reset`). Cannot be combined with `reset_weekday`. The panel ignores it when `reset_day` is set.
- `reset_day` (Number) Calendar renewal day of month 1–31 (`resetDay`). `0` disables monthly renewal. Cannot be combined with `reset_weekday`.
- `reset_max` (Number) Maximum number of auto-renewals (`resetMax`; 0 = unlimited).
- `reset_weekday` (Number) Calendar renewal weekday 1–7, Monday–Sunday (`resetWeekday`). `0` disables weekly renewal. Cannot be combined with `reset` or `reset_day`.
- `sub_id` (String)
- `tg_id` (Number)
- `total_gb` (Number) Traffic limit in **bytes** (panel field `totalGB`; 0 = unlimited).
- `traffic_reset` (String) Per-client traffic reset cycle: `never`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.
- `traffic_reset_day` (Number) Day of month for monthly per-client traffic reset (`trafficResetDay`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Client password from the panel (server-generated unless `password` is set).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xui_masque_client.example 1:masque-client@example.com
```
